title: 第1章 一上来就给爱与美之神按摩
novel_title: 我都天庭临时工了，才神话复苏？(鬼懿)
content_zh: “实习期九个月，实习薪资一千，不签劳动合同。”“对了，我们公司崇尚狼性文化，需要自愿加班。”叶凛靠在椅背上，脸上没什么表情，只是平静地听着。“行，那我九个月后再来入一趟职。”HR脸上的表情绷不住了。“你什么意思？跟我开玩笑呢？”叶凛一脸无辜地摊开手：“不是你先跟我开玩笑的吗？”“只谈奉献不谈钱，这不就是白嫖吗？犯法的姐姐。”“你——！”HR气得正要发作。“我只要五百！五百就干！”一个戴着眼镜，看起来老实巴交的青年猛地挤上前来。他将自已的简历像宝贝一样递到HR面前，一边挤还一边用肩膀狠狠撞了一下叶凛。“姐！我能吃苦！”“我自愿无偿加班！只要公司肯要我！”他谄媚地对着HR笑，还对着叶凛用一种过来人的语气教训道：“你不干有的是人干！”HR脸上的怒气瞬间消散，看向叶凛的目光更是讥讽。她对着那个眼镜青年扬了扬下巴：“明天来上班。”叶凛耸耸肩，转身就走。身后传来眼镜男感激涕零的道谢声，还有HR那句故意提高音量的嘲讽：“现在的年轻人啊，就是没经过社会的毒打。”走出写字楼，叶凛掏出手机，屏幕上推送着一条醒目的新闻——《震惊！昆仑山深处再现金光，灵气复苏或不再是猜想！》他嗤笑一声，划掉了新闻。这些写新闻的真是越来越不要脸了。就算真复苏了又怎么样？到头来，那些所谓的异能者、修仙者，不一样也得给人打工？以当代那些老板的性子，他们不比什么邪修邪神还可怕？至少人家是直接要你的命。而那些流着地主血液的资本家，可是要把人吃干抹净的。“没想到啊，穿越十八年，连大学学费都交不起了。”叶凛自嘲地想着，脑子里在盘算下一顿饭该怎么解决。就在这时。【检测到宿主拥有强烈的“打工”怨念。【诸天打工系统绑定中……】【绑定成功！欢迎您，临时工叶凛。】叶凛脚步一顿，左右看了看。大街上车水马龙，没人注意他。幻听了？不会是昨天的拼好饭有毒吧？【新手引导已开启，请宿主查看个人面板。】眼前视线一花，一个淡蓝色的光幕直接覆盖了现实画面。这UI设计……叶凛眼角抽搐了一下。这配色，这排版，简直和上个世纪九十年代的盗版OA办公软件一模一样，给人一种十分廉价的气息。【姓名：叶凛】【身份：临时工（诸天万界最底层，无五险一金，随时可能被解雇）】【血汗钱：0】【香火钱/信仰值：0（未解锁）】【持有能力/道具：无】【评价：一个除了有点小帅和强壮一点外，一无是处的凡人】叶凛的嘴角抽了抽。系统？临时工？亏你还系统呢，也不知道给个什么签到就变强系统。要是给他一个签到就成神的系统的话，让他每天开豪车住别墅找美女都愿意。他意念一动，点开那个还在闪烁的【接取委托】图标。一排排千奇百怪的任务列表瞬间刷满了他的视野。【委托一：地府急聘！帮判官崔珏跑腿送一瓶特供忘川牌墨水，加急！】【要求：耐阴体质、八字纯阴，女性优先。】【委托二：阿斯加德宴会帮厨！急需一百名能将公牛整个穿在烤架上的壮汉，包吃住，酒水管够！】【要求：力量属性超过50点，持有健康证、厨师证优先。】【委托三：蟠桃园保安紧急招聘！玉帝发现了管理问题——是！谁！让一只猴子看守蟠桃园的？】【要求：对猴毛、桃毛过敏者优先！】【……】叶凛看得眼角直跳。这些要求，他一个都达不到。就在他准备关掉这个“诈骗软件”时，一行金色的文字弹了出来。【新手大礼包已发放，检测到宿主当前状态，已为您匹配首个无需求订单！】【订单内容：前往奥林匹斯神域，为“爱与美之神”阿芙洛狄忒进行全套精油推拿。】【工作要求：让雇主身心愉悦。】【报酬：神力淬体、血汗钱*500、一些你意想不到的东西。】奥林匹斯的爱与美之神？那个希腊神话里以风流闻名的女神？还没等叶凛做出选择，系统已经替他做了决定。【订单已接取，正在传送至工作岗位……】还没等叶凛反应过来，叶凛眼前一闪。再睁眼时，眼前是一座伫立在云端的恢弘神殿。四周是洁白如玉的高大廊柱，一股混合了海风与玫瑰的甜腻香气钻入鼻腔。【检测到宿主已抵达奥林匹斯神域。】【正在加载岗位技能——宗师级推拿专精。】一股暖流瞬间涌入叶凛的双臂。原本因为常年握鼠标而有些僵硬的手指，此刻竟变得如同钢琴家般灵活有力。脑海中更是瞬间多出了无数关于人体穴位、经络疏通以及如何通过触碰挑起感官极致愉悦的知识。叶凛低头看了看自已的手，深吸一口气，推开了面前那扇雕刻着繁复花纹的重木大门。殿内轻纱曼舞，光线暧昧而昏黄。大殿中央，一张几乎能躺下十个人的巨大圆形软榻上，正趴着一个人。或者说，一尊神。阿芙洛狄忒陷在柔软的天鹅绒里，背对着大门。只是一眼，叶凛就感觉呼吸一滞。那不是凡人能拥有的线条。烛火跳动，她的肌肤白得近乎透明，泛着一层淡淡的珍珠光泽。脊背的沟壑顺滑地向下延伸，腰肢收束出一个惊人的弧度。再往下是随着呼吸轻轻起伏的满月。她没穿鞋，双脚随意地交叠在半空，脚踝精致得像艺术品。足弓绷起一道优雅的满月，脚踝纤细精致，十根脚趾圆润剔透，透着淡淡的粉色。宛如剥了壳的荔枝，正随着主人的呼吸轻轻蜷缩、舒展，仿佛在无声邀请。似乎听到了动静，女神微微侧头。金色的长发如瀑布般滑落，遮住了半张脸，却露出了那双仿佛蕴含着整片爱琴海的眸子。那眼神里没有神明的威严，只有傲慢，和一丝被打扰的不悦。“嗯？凡人？”声音沙哑，带着刚睡醒的鼻音，像是羽毛在心尖上轻轻挠了一下。她并没有遮掩的意思。在爱神眼里，被注视是理所当然的供奉。阿芙洛狄忒懒洋洋地打量了叶凛两眼。那眼神不像是在看一个人，更像是在看一个送上门的按摩棒或者别的什么工具。“既然来了，就别在那傻站着。”她重新趴回软榻，把脸埋进臂弯里，一只手随意地向后摆了摆，指尖勾了勾：“要是按得不舒服，我就把你变成花园里那堆石头中的一个。”“过来，干活。”
content_en: "The internship period is nine months, the internship salary is one thousand, and there is no labor contract." "By the way, our company advocates a wolf culture and requires voluntary overtime work." Ye Lin leaned on the back of the chair, with no expression on his face, just listening calmly."Okay, then I'll come back to join you in nine months." The expression on the HR's face couldn't be stretched."What do you mean? Are you kidding me?" Ye Lin spread his hands with an innocent face: "Didn't you joke with me first?" "Only talking about dedication and not about money, isn't this just free prostitution? Sister who broke the law." "You——!" HR was about to explode with anger."I only want 500! I'll do it for 500!" A young man with glasses and an honest look rushed forward.He handed his resume to HR like a treasure, and while squeezing it back, he bumped Ye Lin hard with his shoulder."Sister! I can endure hardship!" "I voluntarily work overtime for free! As long as the company wants me!" He smiled flatteringly at HR, and lectured Ye Lin in an experienced tone: "If you don't do it, others will do it!" The anger on HR's face dissipated instantly, and the look he looked at Ye Lin was even more sarcastic.She raised her chin at the young man with glasses and said, "Come to work tomorrow." Ye Lin shrugged, turned around and left.Behind him came the grateful voice of the bespectacled man, and the HR's sarcastic words that deliberately raised the volume: "Today's young people have never been beaten by society." After walking out of the office building, Ye Lin took out his mobile phone, and a striking news was pushed on the screen - "Shocked!"The golden light reappears deep in the Kunlun Mountains, and the revival of spiritual energy may no longer be conjecture!” He sneered and crossed out the news.These news writers are becoming more and more shameless.So what if I really recover?In the end, those so-called superpowers and immortal cultivators still have to work for others?Given the temperament of contemporary bosses, aren’t they more terrifying than evil cultivators and evil gods?At least they are directly trying to kill you.And those capitalists who have the blood of landlords want to eat people up and wipe them clean."I didn't expect that after traveling eighteen years, I couldn't even afford college tuition." Ye Lin thought mockingly to himself, thinking about what to do for the next meal.Just then.[It is detected that the host has a strong resentment of "working".[Zhutian Part-time Job System is being bound...] [Binding successful!Welcome, temporary worker Ye Lin.] Ye Lin paused and looked around.The street was busy with traffic, and no one paid attention to him.Hallucinated?Could it be that the rice from yesterday was poisonous?[The novice guide has been opened, please check the personal panel.】The vision in front of me blurred, and a light blue light curtain directly covered the real picture.This UI design... Ye Lin's eyes twitched.The color scheme and layout are exactly the same as the pirated OA office software from the 1990s, giving it a very cheap vibe.[Name: Ye Lin] [Identity: Temporary worker (the lowest level in the universe, without five insurances and one housing fund, and may be fired at any time)] [Earned money: 0] [Incense money/faith value: 0 (unlocked)] [Ability/props held: none] [Evaluation: A mortal with nothing but a little handsomeness and strength] Ye Lin's mouth twitched.system?Temporary worker?It's a shame that you're giving the system back, and I don't know how to strengthen the system by giving you a sign-in.If you give him a system where he becomes a god upon signing in, he will be willing to drive a luxury car, live in a villa and find beautiful women every day.With a thought, he clicked on the still flashing [Accept Commission] icon.Rows of strange task lists instantly filled his field of vision.[Commission 1: Urgent recruitment from the underworld!Run errands for Judge Cui Jue and deliver a bottle of special Wangchuan brand ink, hurry up!】【Requirements: Yin-tolerant physique, pure Yin in the horoscope, women are preferred.】【Commission 2: As a cook for the Asgard banquet!We urgently need a hundred strong men who can put a whole bull on the grill. Food, accommodation, and drinks are included!】【Requirements: Strength attribute exceeds 50 points, health certificate and chef certificate are preferred.】【Commission 3: Pantaoyuan Security Urgent Recruitment!The Jade Emperor discovered the management problem - yes!who!Let a monkey guard the peach garden?】【Requirement: Priority will be given to those allergic to monkey hair and peach hair!】【...】Ye Lin's eyes twitched when he saw it.He could not meet any of these requirements.Just when he was about to close this "fraud software", a line of golden text popped up.[The novice gift package has been distributed, the current status of the host has been detected, and the first no-demand order has been matched for you!】【Order content: Go to the Olympus Divine Realm and give Aphrodite, the "Goddess of Love and Beauty", a full set of essential oil massages.】【Job requirements: Make the employer happy both physically and mentally.】【Reward: Divine Power Tempered Body, hard-earned money*500, something you can’t expect.】The Olympian god of love and beauty?That goddess in Greek mythology who was famous for her romance?Before Ye Lin could make a choice, the system had already made the decision for him.[The order has been received and is being sent to the work station...] Before Ye Lin could react, Ye Lin's eyes flashed.When he opened his eyes again, he saw a magnificent temple standing in the clouds.Surrounded by tall pillars as white as jade, a sweet scent of sea breeze and roses penetrated the nostrils.[It is detected that the host has arrived in Olympus.】【Loading job skills - master level massage specialization.】A warm current surged into Ye Lin's arms instantly.The fingers that were originally a little stiff from holding the mouse for many years now became as flexible and powerful as a pianist.In an instant, countless knowledge about human acupuncture points, dredging of meridians, and how to stimulate the ultimate pleasure of the senses through touch came to mind.Ye Lin looked down at his hands, took a deep breath, and opened the heavy wooden door in front of him that was carved with complicated patterns.The light gauze dances in the hall, and the light is ambiguous and dim.In the center of the hall, on a huge round soft couch that could accommodate almost ten people, a person was lying on his back.In other words, a god.Aphrodite sank into the soft velvet, her back to the door.Just one glance made Ye Lin feel his breath hitched.Those are not lines that mere mortals can possess.The candlelight danced, and her skin was almost transparent, with a faint pearly luster.The ravine on the back extended smoothly downward, and the waist formed an astonishing arc.Below is the full moon rising and falling gently with its breath.She didn't wear shoes, her feet were folded casually in the air, and her ankles were as delicate as works of art.The arch of the foot stretched into an elegant full moon, the ankle was slender and delicate, and the ten toes were round and translucent, with a touch of pink.Like a peeled lychee, it is curling up and stretching gently with the owner's breathing, as if it is a silent invitation.As if hearing the movement, the goddess turned her head slightly.Her long golden hair fell down like a waterfall, covering half of her face, but revealing her eyes that seemed to contain the entire Aegean Sea.There was no godly majesty in those eyes, only arrogance and a hint of displeasure at being disturbed."Huh? Mortal?" The voice was hoarse, with a nasal sound that just woke up, like a feather gently tickling the apex of his heart.She had no intention of covering up.In the eyes of the God of Love, being watched is a natural offering.Aphrodite looked at Ye Lin lazily.The look in his eyes didn't look like he was looking at a person, but more like he was looking at a vibrator or other tool delivered to his door."Now that you're here, don't just stand there." She lay down on the soft couch again, buried her face in her arms, waved one hand back casually, and hooked her fingertips: "If you feel uncomfortable, I will turn you into one of those piles of stones in the garden." "Come here and work."
